info.title: FTL Pricing Dashboard
info.description: Internal FTL (full-truckload) pricing dashboard: sales upload shipper details, add-ons and rate requests, get a computed final rate against master vendor-cost data, and escalate lanes to Vendor Management, who work a prioritized request queue and resolve rates lane-by-lane.

get.summary: Readiness probe.
Return the signed-in user's email (from SSO), their provisioned role (sales/vm/superadmin), if any, and the permission map the UI renders from.
Superadmin: list all users and their provisioned role.

post.summary: Superadmin: add a user or change an existing user's role (sales/vm/superadmin).

delete.summary: Superadmin: revoke a user's access entirely.

post.summary: Sales: upload shipper details, add-ons, and a CSV of OD + vehicle-type rate requests (optional columns: Target Rate, Minimum trip). Lanes with fewer than 2 vendors get no rate and are raised to VM automatically.

add_ons_json.description: JSON array of {label, value?}; metadata only, doesn't affect Final Rate.

sales_email.description: Email of a sales-role user; sales_pic should carry their display name.

get.summary: List submissions: scope=mine (default, sales only) is the user's own incl. drafts; scope=all is every submitted request, readable by any role.
Fetch one submission and its rows: the owner gets their own (drafts too); any role may read a submitted one. Vendor names only for roles with vendor-data access.

delete.summary: Sales: discard a draft (not yet submitted) submission, e.g. when Check Result is re-run.

post.summary: Sales: submit a draft. Lanes in ask_vm_row_ids and single-vendor lanes become VM tickets; unpriced lanes not asked are marked 'Not requested'; ticked additional services become one VM price request.

get.summary: Sales: list the VM requests (tickets) raised from this submission's rows — active (open/in_progress) vs completed (resolved/closed_no_vendor).
Sales: download an Excel quotation of this submission's rows that currently have a Final Rate.
Sales: every VM request this user has raised, across all their submissions — feeds the global Active/Completed Request views.

Sales: every lane from every one of this user's submissions, not just ones raised to VM. A lane is active while it has a currently open/in_progress VM request; otherwise it's completed if it has a Final Rate or an explicit no-vendor outcome. Feeds the global Active/Completed Request views (which cover ALL requested OD lanes, not only escalated ones).
Any provisioned user: the full roster (email + role), for @mention autocomplete in a discussion thread.
The current user's personal notifications (currently: @mentions in a submission discussion), newest first, plus an unread count.

post.summary: Mark one of the current user's notifications as read.
Mark all of the current user's unread notifications as read.

get.summary: The current user's per-submission "last viewed" timestamps, used to show a "New" badge on tickets they haven't opened yet.

post.summary: Mark a submission's ticket/discussion as viewed by the current user (upserts their ticket_views row), clearing its "New" badge for them.

get.summary: List the discussion thread on a VM request (visible to sales/VM/superadmin; persists across open, resolved and closed states).

post.summary: Post a message to a VM request's discussion thread. Used only for ad-hoc requests with no parent submission — submission-linked requests use the shipper-level thread instead.

get.summary: List the discussion thread on a shipper (submission) — shared across every VM request raised from its rows, surviving a lane's move from active to completed.

post.summary: Post a message to a shipper's discussion thread.
Sales: escalate a lane (an existing submission row, or ad hoc) to Vendor Management.

get.summary: Dashboard Ticket: every raised ticket (one submitted request, several lanes), newest first, with ticket number (FTL-000123), lane count, vehicles, whether any lane has a target rate, and how many lanes wait on VM. vm_only=true is the VM queue (VM/procurement/superadmin only).

put.summary: The ticket's owner edits one lane (OD, vehicle, target rate, min trips) until VM starts on the ticket; the lane is re-priced from master rates and its VM request created or updated as needed.

403.description: Not the owner, or VM already started

put.summary: Set a ticket's OD Region (CJ, EJ, GJ, WJ, Sumatra, Kalimantan, Sulawesi, Bali-Nusa, Papua-Maluku). The person who raised it or a superadmin.

post.summary: Mark a ticket's shipper as live (Go-live). Allowed once no lane waits on VM and at least one lane has a final rate.

400.description: Already live, lanes waiting on VM, or no final rate

delete.summary: Undo a go-live marked by mistake.

get.summary: Sales: every OD + vehicle combination with at least one vendor rate on file, so sales knows what can be served. Only the lane: no price, vendor names, costs or vendor counts.

Every lane-level vendor-management request (open/in_progress first) with aging_days, optionally for one ticket. Readable by all roles; vendor names, costs and rankings are stripped for roles without vendor-data access (sales).

patch.summary: VM: update a request's status directly, or record the vendor/cost it resolved at.

post.summary: VM: submit one or more vendor costs for this request's lane; upserts them into master vendor rates, recomputes the Final Rate (and the originating submission row's), and marks the request resolved.
VM: same as /resolve, but vendor costs come from a CSV (rows not matching this request's lane are ignored); also upserts into the main master vendor rates.

VM: decline to find a rate. If this lane never had a Final Rate, closes as closed_no_vendor and clears it. If it already had one (sales was asking for a lower rate), closes as closed_no_lower_rate and leaves the existing Final Rate untouched.
VM: bulk-resolve every open/in_progress request (optionally scoped to one shipper, or the ad-hoc bucket via shipper_name=__unknown__) whose lane already has master vendor-rate data.

VM: upload a CSV (Origin L2 | Destinasi L2 | Vehicle Type | Cost/Rate | Vendor Name); each row is upserted — existing lanes not present in the file are kept. Also auto-resolves any open/in_progress requests on the uploaded lanes.

get.summary: VM: metadata about the most recent master vendor-rate upload/resolve action.
VM: list every stored (origin, destination, vehicle type, vendor, cost) row.
VM: download all master vendor rates as a CSV file.

Prioritization summary (readable by all roles) — 'seeking_lower_rate' is still-open requests with an existing Final Rate the sales target didn't meet; 'missing_lanes' is lanes VM has already closed as closed_no_vendor, accumulated by how often that's happened. Both ranked by count; default top 10, pass a higher limit for the full list.

post.summary: VM: price a ticket from the lane's one and only vendor. Ticket-level approval; sales then sees the rate with remark 'Confirmed by VM', and an automatic note is added to the shipper's Discussion.

get.summary: VM: distinct vendor names in the master data, for the vendor dropdown.
Shippers that can be picked to go live: all tickets closed, at least one priced lane, not already live.

post.summary: Confirm shippers as going live: freezes Sheet 1 (quotation cost) from their priced lanes and notifies VM.

get.summary: Live shippers (the Tracker tab).

post.summary: VM/superadmin: move shippers back to 'Pilih Go Live'; their sheets are kept.

get.summary: A live shipper's two sheets: quotation cost and orders. Vendor, cost and margin columns are blank for roles without vendor-data access.

put.summary: Replace a live shipper's Sheet 1 (quotation cost) rows. VM/superadmin only.
Replace a live shipper's Sheet 2 (orders) rows. VM/superadmin only.

get.summary: Sales: selling price (cost x 1.111) of the 3 cheapest vendors on a lane; the 2nd is the Final Rate. Fewer than 2 vendors: available=false. Nothing is saved; vendor names/costs are not returned.
Sales: this user's additional-service price requests and VM's answers.
Every additional-service price request, readable by all roles; the winning vendor of each lane only for roles with vendor-data access.

put.summary: VM: set the unit price of, or mark unavailable, the services of one request.

permissions.description: What this user may see/do (backend/permissions.py): viewQueue, viewSubmissions, viewProfitability, comment, confirmGoLive, createRequest, quickCheck, workTickets, manageRates, editProfitability, seeVendorData, manageUsers.

real_role.description: The user's actual role; differs from role while a superadmin uses View as (X-View-As header).

view_as_options.description: Roles a superadmin may preview as; empty for everyone else.

display_name.description: Human-friendly name; shown in the Sales PIC dropdown and Sales filters.
Human-friendly name; shown in the Sales PIC dropdown and Sales filters.

service.description: Set for services VM prices on request.

raised_to_vm.description: True while an open VM ticket exists for this row.

needs_vm.description: Single-vendor lane in a draft: always sent to VM on submit.

sales_email.description: The sales user this submission belongs to; null on legacy submissions that only have a typed sales_pic.

submitted_at.description: Null while the submission is a draft.

od_region.description: CJ, EJ, GJ, WJ, or the island for lanes outside Java; chosen by sales.

went_live_at.description: When the ticket was marked live (Go-live).

editable.description: The viewer raised this ticket and VM hasn't started on any lane.

target_cost.description: target_rate / 1.111 — shown to VM instead of the raw shipper target.

submission_id.description: The parent submission (shipper), when this request came from one; null for ad-hoc requests.

shipper_name.description: From the originating submission, when this request came from one; null for ad-hoc requests.

sales_pic.description: Sales PIC from the originating submission.

auto_closed_sla.description: Closed automatically after 7 days with no VM action.

only_one_vendor.description: VM views only: the lane has exactly one vendor.

winner_basis.description: VM views only: e.g. '2nd cheapest of 3 vendors'.

ranked_vendors.description: VM views only: full ranked vendor list at pricing time.

submitted_at.description: When the parent submission (the shipper's CSV/manual batch) was created.

vm_status.description: Set only when there's a currently open/in_progress VM request for this lane.

display_name.description: Human-friendly name; shown in the Sales PIC dropdown and Sales filters.

avg_target_rate.description: Average target_rate across the requests grouped into this lane (seeking_lower_rate bucket only).

resolved_count.description: How many open/in_progress VM requests were auto-resolved by this upload.

reason.description: 'No other vendor serves this lane', 'Dedicated/contract rate', or 'Other: <text>'.

margin_pct.description: Policy margin of the lane (11.1 or 6.1, incl. PPN).

unit.description: per malam / per orang / per titik
